en:
Guess y'really don't understand
what's goin' on here.
Yer 'bout to become history.

What y'do now determines
whether or not I let ya live.

That's funny.
I was thinking the same thing.

Step aside if you don't want to die.
If you leave now, I'll let this slide.

I'm sick o' yer smug bullshit. But that's gonna
make it even more satisfyin' to beat yer ass.

Time's up.
Let's go!

Wait, the Tojo Clan Fourth Chairman?
Y'mean like, the Tojo Clan from Tokyo!?
That one.

Then... I know who y'are. The Dragon o' Dojima!
I read about ya in a magazine once.

Hey, what's up with y'guys?
Why aren't ya surprised?
Is he really that famous?

Huh? What're y'talkin' about!?
He's legendary fer bein' a ruthless yakuza!
This guy's incredible!

Kiryu-aniki. Why'd y'try to hide this
from us? Y'should've told us way sooner.

I left that life in the past.
I'm just a civilian now.
But I guess there's nothing left to hide.
At least, <font_kind=yakuza_italic>I'm</font_kind> not hiding anything.
What d'ya mean, Kiryu-san?

He means there's still
somethin' we're hiding from him.
That's what he means.

Well, what're ya hiding?
C'mon, Nagumo. I can keep a secret.
Huh? W-Well, uh...

It's fine. I'm heading home for tonight.
I need to get back to Haruto.

Hey, Nagumo.
Let's hear this secret.

(Mama said she'd bring Haruto back to the
apartment. She's probably waiting there.)

Hi there. Sorry I'm late.
Have you been here long?

Not really. Haruto-kun's fast asleep.
He's been in a great mood today, though.

That's good. Did you want to
come inside for a bit?

Oh no, it's getting late. Anyway,
how are things with the Masuzoe Family?
Fine, for now at least.

I'm glad to hear that.
Well, here's Haruto-kun.

I really shouldn't keep asking you
to take care of him.

What about the Hirose guys?
Did they tell you anything about Haruka?
No, I didn't get the chance to ask.

I'll give it some more time.
I still think they'll come clean themselves.

No no, it's nothing.
Well, good night.
Same to you. Thanks again.
Aniki. It's Nagumo.
Nagumo...?

Kiyo-chan told me where yer stayin'.
I've got somethin' I wanna tell ya, Aniki.

Haruto's sleeping, so let's talk outside.
Do you mind?
Not a lick.

As y'can probly guess,
I came t'talk about Haruka-san.

Truth is, everyone in the family
knew Haruka-san when she was here.

Soon as y'showed us that picture over at
the office, we figured out who y'were.

Kiryu-aniki. Yer Haruka's guardian and the
Tojo Clan Fourth Chairman... Kazuma Kiryu.

Pretty sure Matsunaga didn't quite
put the pieces together, though.

Lemme tell ya, that thick skull o' his
serves him good sometimes.

Sorry fer how rude we were to ya.
Hope ya can accept my apology.

Oh, and there's a reason we didn't tell
ya 'bout us knowin' Haruka-san.
She never gave us permission.
Go on.

Haruka-san blew in to town
somewhere 'round three years ago.

At first, she didn't much feel like
talkin' about herself.

She was always careful
o' who could've been around.

T'be honest, it looked kinda like
she'd ran away from home t'come here.

Here in the sticks,
outsiders stand out like a sore thumb.

But she was the cutest girl yokels like
us'd ever seen. She got popular real quick.
Whenever Haruka-san was 'round...

...Everyone'd be on their best behavior.
My family, the shipbuilders, the fishermen.

Soon enough, people took t'thinkin' of her
as a damn important part of Onomichi.

Nobody could bring 'emselves to
mention her past life as a celebrity.
So you did know.

Don't even need to watch TV to
sort that out.

We knew Haruka-san was tryin'
t'stay outta the public eye, too.

We jus' wanted t'protect her from
the world she was hopin' to escape.

That's why we were tryin' to hide
what we knew about her.

I know y'wanted info
on Haruka-san, Aniki...

...But we jus' couldn't do that t'her.
The whole town probly thought the same.

Huh, you're more considerate than I took
you for. I can see why Haruka felt at home.

Um, Aniki.
Speakin' of Haruka-san...

Right. I actually went to Kiyomi's to ask
about her after our conversation last night.
Kiyo-chan... Did she tell ya anythin'?

Actually, she wasn't there,
so I couldn't ask her.

Weird.
She's usually at the bar 'round then.
She left a note for me, though.
And what did it say?

Apparently she wants to
talk to me alone.

I'm meeting her up at the
top of the ropeway tonight.

How 'bout that.
Guess she's the same as us, then.

Even Kiyo-chan's sick of hidin'
the truth about Haruka-san from ya.
Why do you sound so damn proud of yerself?

You couldn't lie to save your life, Cap.
Could'ya have been more obvious?

Shut yer sorry mouth!
That ain't true!

Aniki didn't realize we had any info
'til I talked t'him last night!

Not quite. I've known since I showed you
the photo. It was written all over your face.

If you want to compare acting chops,
I'd say Haruto has you beat.

Y-Y'gotta be kiddin' me!
Gimme a break, Aniki!

(I still have time before my meeting with
Kiyomi. Maybe I'll check out the town.)

(It's almost time for my
meeting with Kiyomi.)

(We're supposed to meet at the top of the
ropeway. I should head to the station...)
He finally fell asleep.
Aniki. We'll watch the kid.

If yer meetin' up with Kiyo-chan,
y'should jus' leave him to us.

I bet he'll be thrilled about
lyin' here asleep while yer out.
Y'don't gotta worry.
Thanks for the help.

Would you like to buy a ticket?
One way is 320 yen.
A one-way ticket, please.

Sure, here you go. Trams run every
15 minutes, so thanks for your patience.
A round trip ticket, please.
No, I'm all right for now.

Please come again. Keep in mind,
the tram only runs during the day.
(Looks like the tram doesn't run at night.)
(Should I head back to town?)
(I don't have enough money...)

Kiryu-san. I know this is a little
out of the way. Sorry about that.
No, it's all right.

Nagumo-kun told you, didn't he? About
how Haruka-chan used to work for me.

Yeah, he did. If you don't mind,
can you tell me how Haruka got here?

The first time we met was
three years ago, down by the harbor.

She was gazing out at the water
with the saddest look on her face.

I thought maybe she would jump,
so I called out to her.
That's how we started talking.

It didn't take long to learn Haruka-chan
had nowhere to go.

She was a runaway, all alone in the country.
I couldn't abandon someone so vulnerable.

So, I decided to offer her a futon at
my place, at least for the night.

Before the evening was gone, it was
clear something was bothering her.
I could tell she was a nice girl, though.

That's when I asked her if she wanted
to take a job at my bar for a while.

As you know, I can handle the bar just
fine by myself, but she needed help.

From that day forward,
we had a partnership.

You know, Haruka-chan never seemed like
the idol type. She was always so sweet.

So you had already realized
who she was by then.

Yes, but... Even though the whole town
knew, they still treated her like normal.

As the months passed, Haruka-chan
started smiling more and more.
That is, until that day.

She came in with tears in her eyes,
but even then she was grinning through it.
To this day, I wish I'd asked what was wrong.

The next day, she disappeared
from this town for good.

Knowing Haruka, I'd bet she'd just learned
she was pregnant. That must be why she left.
Yeah, I think you're right.
Sounds like you have history with him.

I don't want to pry into your past, though.
All I'm after is details about Haruka.
But, I think that can wait for now.
No, don't be.
Thank you, Kiryu-san.
W-Wait, what the shit happened!?

Well, I was over at Kiyomi's bar
when some yakuza jus' busted in.
They forced 'er to get in their car.

I tried to stop 'em, but all I got
was the crap beaten outta me.

As they were drivin' away,
Kiyo-chan told me not t'worry...

So y'chose to run here instead'a helpin'!?
Y'freakin' coward!

Ain't savin' Kiyo-chan worth breakin'
a goddamn arm or two!?

Cap, stop!
He already took a beatin'!

What about these yakuza?
Were they Yomei Alliance men?

N-No, looked like some Tokyo group.
The boss looked young.

So it's true. There really was
somethin' between him and Kiyomi.

Hold on, Nagumo.
Where do you think you're going?

Can't y'tell?
I'm gonna go save Kiyo-chan.

This Someya fella's stayin' in
the hotel up on the hill, ain't he?

Don't take the Tojo lightly.
You can't handle them alone.

I'm not backin' down.
This is one order o' yers I can't follow, Aniki.

Hold up! Y'ain't gotta do this alone, Cap.
We're comin' with ya!
Kiyomi-san means the world to us too, y'know!

That's right! We ain't gonna sit around n'
let some Tokyo assholes humiliate us!

Did you forget that Someya
is here as a Yomei Alliance guest?

If you guys just barge in there, you'll
stand to lose more than your pinkies.

They could shut the Hirose Family down in
a heartbeat. Think about your patriarch.
Fine then. I'll offer t'leave the family!

I'll take responsibility fer our actions
and cut my ties t'the Hirose!

A yakuza who can't protect the woman
he loves ain't a true yakuza!

Seriously?
You guys are pretty stupid sometimes.

Say whatever y'wanna say.
We're doin' this whether y'like it or not.

Right. You may be stupid,
but your plan's stupid enough to work.

The Hirose Family can't be involved, though.
If I do this alone, nobody has to get punished.
Am I wrong?
W-Well, I know yer real strong n' all, Aniki...

...But it'd be suicide if y'tried to
go in there all on yer own.
Hey, what's all the fuss about?
Boss! Yer here too?

Hey, all you need is a way to keep 'em
from knowing you're in the family, right?
Yeah, I guess yer right.

Well, I've got just the trick.
Check it out.

Well, I should be on my way.
Good luck, you guys.

All right, Cap.
What's our gameplan here?
Lemme think.

Wait, I think we've got one o' them
hotel pamphlets somewhere 'round here.
I'll go grab it.

Here we go.
This is a map of the hotel.

Apparently, they built it fer people who were
comin' to buy ships from Iwami Shipbuilding.

First floor's the lobby, second n' third're guest rooms,
and the fourth is a restaurant and bath.

Looks like the fifth floor's jus'
some kinda fancy suite.

It's fuckin' huge. How're we
s'posed to find Kiyomi in there?

If we take too long, we'll have
the whole Tojo Clan to deal with.

All right, this is how we're
gonna save Kiyo-chan.

First off, we bust in the front door n'
head up the stairs t'the second floor.

There we'll split in two n'
check all the guest rooms.

Matsunaga, Tagashira, n' Yuta'll go to the
right. Me n' Kiryu-aniki'll head to the left.

If we can't find her on the second floor,
we'll head up t'the third n' do it again.

If yer group finds Kiyo-chan,
gimme a call right away.

Then once we've got her, we run down
t'the lobby and zoom off in our escape car!
So, y'guys all set?
This is gettin' good now!
Aniki. Are y'ready to go?

Kiyo-chan might be in more danger
than we realize. Try n' hurry, okay?
Yeah, let's do this.
All right! We're comin' fer ya, Kiyo-chan!
She wasn't in any of our rooms, Cap.
Guess Kiyo-chan ain't on this floor, then.
All right, let's head up.

Goddammit!
Where the hell is Kiyo-chan at!?

We're gonna have t'convince Someya t'tell us.
Nothin' a few punches can't fix, though.
Someya's up in the bathhouse!

Kiryu-aniki.
Let's get goin' to the fourth floor.

Cap! We'll go on n' check the rooms
over this way.
Let's head up.
Wh-Who the hell're you!?
So, where's Someya?
You. Show me your face.
Hey, whaddya think you're doing!?
Not him.

You bastards...
You think you can take us!?
Go after Someya, Aniki.

Isn't this view incredible?
I love how Onomichi looks from the water.

Beyond that, there is no better place than
this to discuss important matters.

We can speak freely here without
fear of any eavesdropping.
Important matters?

To be honest, Kiryu-san...
I have a request to make of you.

I would like you to bear witness to the pact
sworn between Koshimizu and Someya-san.
What are you talking about?

As I'm sure you know, the Yomei Alliance has
never allied with either the Tojo or the Omi.

We have always chosen to
remain a neutral party.
Why do you think that is?

Our moving outside of Hiroshima would disrupt
the equilibrium of the entire yakuza world.

If we sided with the far larger Omi Alliance,
the Tojo Clan would have no hope of survival.

But if we joined with the Tojo Clan instead,
the Omi's existence would also be in peril.

If the Omi Alliance were to learn of the pact
we are hoping to make with the Tojo Clan...
